notes.title: Game updated!
notes.notes:
We looked at the players letsplays and made some changes to the game.

First, we changed the colors of the skills, it seemed to us that it is hard to see which skills are available and which are not.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34573565/9c4296eeb3be12f2f8c3a38f1576159ab1e3b1d1.png[/img]

Secondly, we realized that the gargoyles are doing something strange in our game. Therefore, we have changed them. Now gargolia can remove items from inventory.
[img]http://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34573565/db39864dc9c11f0483043e92b65b273601d2f1ad.png[/img]

Thirdly, we improved the ending of the game: made it more understandable.

Fourth, made minor changes.
